record.question: Dry powders for reconstitution are mainly used when:
options: The drug is stable for a long time in aqueous medium
The drug decomposes quickly when it is dissolved
The drug is in the form of an oily preparation
record.explanation: Answer B: The drug decomposes quickly when it is dissolved. A drug that decomposes rapidly in water may be supplied as a dry powder to be reconstituted shortly before use. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK562178/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
